stories.title: Sen. Lindsey Graham of South Carolina, Trump ally and foreign policy hawk, dies at 71
stories.summary: His office said Graham died Saturday night after a "brief and sudden illness." The Republican senator was instrumental in enacting Trump's policy and staffing priorities.

stories.title: New security system causes major delays at Europe's airports amid peak travel season
stories.summary: The European Union recently implemented a new security system to better monitor foreigners who enter and exit. But its messy rollout has upended the summer travel season.

stories.title: President Trump says ceasefire with Iran is over. What happens next?
stories.summary: NPR's Don Gonyea speaks with Ariane Tabatabai, Vice President of Research, Security and Defense, at the Chicago Council on Global Affairs, about developments in the war between the U.S. and Iran.

stories.title: Why do baseball movies make for some of the most enduring sports movies?
stories.summary: Baseball isn't just America's pastime, it's also the backdrop for many of our greatest sports movies.

stories.title: Palestinian aid worker who organized World Cup screenings killed in Israeli strike
stories.summary: Palestinians are mourning Mohammed al-Wahidi, a beloved aid worker in Gaza. He was killed by as Israeli airstrike while en route to a World Cup screening which he organized.

stories.title: This English professor has run with the bulls in Spain for two decades
stories.summary: When Bill Hillmann was 19 years old, he read Ernest Hemingway's The Sun Also Rises. That book inspired him to pursue two dreams: a career in literature and to run with the bulls in Pamplona, Spain.
